categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including ownership details, property boundaries, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The document is explicitly published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and property rights rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
